title: Guest orders undertaken (the ruby set)
caption:
Guest orders undertaken. Wedding season is open, and so is the counter.

The ruby set, in ruby-red cubic zirconia: necklace ₹2,099, bracelet ₹1,599, huggies ₹1,199. Also in crystal and green.

Take any 2 pieces for 10% off, or 3 for 20% off. The bag applies it for you (BUY2 or BUY3), one offer per order.

[ the ruby set · 18k gold tone plated · for the guest who gets photographed ]
first_comment:
Send the card and the outfit on WhatsApp, +91 95615 57935, Mon to Sat, 10 am to 7 pm. Free insured shipping, COD available.
#NairaFlore #NairaPetite #WeddingGuest #WeddingSeason #TennisBracelet
alt_text: A deep oxblood tile. A cream painted shop signboard with a fine gold double rule and a screw in each corner reads NAIRA, Matching Centre in Marathi, and Guest orders undertaken. Below, on a Paithani-purple silk swatch with a gold zari border and zigzag pinked edges, a gold-tone tennis necklace, tennis bracelet and pair of huggie earrings, all set with ruby-red baguette stones; the necklace's long end runs off the bottom of the frame. A fine gold thread runs from the board's bottom-right screw to an ivory hang-tag with a ruby-red top reading Shade N° 12, matched to every muhurat, the ruby set.

A deep oxblood tile. A photograph in a cream border, cropped below the chin: a woman in a mustard satin slip rests her hand at her collarbone, wearing a gold-tone tennis necklace and a matching tennis bracelet of ruby-red baguette stones. Below it: The full match. In italics: necklace, bracelet and huggies, in ruby-red. In small capitals: shown, necklace and bracelet, ruby.

A deep oxblood tile. A paper bill with a torn top edge, headed Naira Matching Centre, Bill N° 12, lists three items, each with a small picture: Baguette Tennis Necklace, ruby, 36 cm, ₹2,099; Baguette Tennis Bracelet, ruby, about 17 cm, ₹1,599; Baguette Huggies, ruby, about 18 mm, ₹1,199. Below a dashed line, Total ₹4,897. In italics at the foot of the bill: matched to: every muhurat this season. matched in N° 01, N° 07 and N° 09. Under the bill: three pieces, one shade. 18k gold tone plated, ruby-red cubic zirconia.

A deep oxblood tile. Small type at the top reads N° 12, the shades. Headed Also in crystal and green. Three gold-tone baguette tennis bracelets of the same size, stacked one above another and labelled crystal (clear stones), ruby (larger ruby-red stones) and green (green stones). At the foot, in italics: the whole set comes in all three.

An ivory tile. Small type at the top reads N° 12, guest orders. Headed Guest orders on WhatsApp. In italics: send the card and the outfit. we'll send back three matches, with photographs. A photograph of two hands sliding open a blush Naira gift box, NAIRA printed on the lid, black velvet inside. Below: every piece arrives in the Naira gift box. +91 95615 57935, Monday to Saturday, 10 to 7. Free insured shipping, COD available.
deviations: Slide 1 necklace: cutouts/baguette-tennis-necklace/01-trim.png ends mid-stone at the source frame (the photo drapes the tail down the plinth's front face and out of shot; bbox bottom = 1055 of 1055). At the specified 460 tall, centred (280,1075), the cut end would lie on the organza at about y1305 and read as a severed necklace (P9 met the same on the Crystal 00-trim). It is now 560 tall x 418 wide (0.53x native), centred (330,1172), rotated -4deg as specified, so the tail runs off the foot of the frame. The swatch keeps its specified x72-730 top and sides and its +2deg rotation about the spec centre (401,1080), but runs on past the bottom edge (y800 to 1500) so the tail lies on organza all the way out. The 4:5 crop still holds every critical element. The contact shadow sits under the loop (centre (320,1100), 300 wide), because the necklace's lowest pixel is off-canvas.

Slide 1 bracelet and huggies: the bracelet is centred (538,1212) at +8deg (spec (585,950)), and the huggies are 170 wide at (628,975), -4deg (spec 150 at (590,1210)). The larger necklace loop fills the swatch's upper left to x of about 525, so the bracelet sits in the bend right of the tail and the huggies nest beside the loop. The three pieces are 30-90px apart, all inside the swatch and clear of the tag box (x>=740 for y>=1010). At 170 an 18 mm huggie is also closer to true scale beside a 17 cm bracelet.

Cleaned mattes: all seven cut-outs (Ruby 01/01/00 and Crystal 00/00/01, plus the Emerald 02 bracelet) are same-size copies in p12/assets, made by _work/defringe.py with P8's method (1px erosion of the binary matte's plaster ring, edge colour from the nearest kept pixel, 0.6px soft edge). p12.js registers them with the source trims' size and hull, so the system's sizing and contact shadows are unchanged. No piece is recoloured, redrawn or mirrored. The shared cutouts/ folder is untouched.

Slide 2: the 12px cream border sits inside the specified 900x833 box (system a-print), so the photo is 876x809, cropped (83,245)-(1117,1200), below the jaw (Ruby build: (20,245)-(1054,1200), see the next entry; the source drawn at 0.847x, object-fit fill, so the bottom edge is the source's own and the worn bracelet shows whole with wrist below it). The whole slide moves down 30px (print y170-1003, headline b1130, turn b1200, credit b1270). As specified, the margins were 140px at the top and 200px under the credit; they are now 170 and 170. The border is cream #F6EFE6 with the dark-ground paper shadow, as specified.

Slide 2, Ruby build only: the window is (20,245)-(1054,1200) of 08.jpg, the reviewed crop moved 63 source px left at the same 0.847x and the same top and bottom. In 08.jpg the fingertips reach x35 (ring), x68 (middle) and x74 (little); a window from x83 clipped all three nails at the frame edge (checked at 2x), so 'all four fingertips in' held for 07.jpg but not 08.jpg. Below the jaw (the chin ends at about y232) the window can be at most 1034 px wide, which cannot hold both the ring fingertip (x35) and the right strap's run to the shoulder (x~1150). The fingertips are the gesture, so they win: the ring tip now sits 13 px inside the frame, the whole necklace curve is in, and the right strap enters the frame at the right edge and runs to the bodice. The Crystal build (07.jpg) keeps the reviewed (83,245)-(1117,1200) exactly; all four fingertips are in there with 25+ px to spare. Pixel diff of the renders against those windows: mean error 3.0 and 2.9.

Slide 3 bill: 740 wide, x170-910 (spec 720, x180-900), with a 45px inner margin (x215-865). Item names, details and TOTAL sit at x375 (spec x400), and thumbnails are centred in a 130px column (x215-345). Measured in Chromium, 'Baguette Tennis Necklace' at the specified Cormorant 38px is 340px wide. From x400 it ran to x740, while the right-aligned ₹2,300 started at x734. The name now ends at x715 and the price starts at x749 (₹2,300; the 27 Oct price ₹2,099 is 3 px wider and starts at x746, still 31 px clear). The whole slide moves up 32px (bill y148-1148, turn b1258, kicker b1314); as specified the bill top sat 180px down while the kicker left 94px at the foot. 'matched in N° 01, N° 07 and N° 09.' is set with lining figures: Cormorant's oldstyle 0 read as a lowercase o ('N° o1').

Slide 4: the three bracelets are drawn at ONE width, 440 (spec 500 each), centred on x540: one ~17 cm piece in three shades, so one outline. The Ruby's baguettes are larger and fewer than the Crystal's in the product itself (front-row stone pitch on the native cut-outs: Crystal 41.5 px of 840, Ruby 74 of 868, Green 56 of 850, about 22 / 38 / 29 px on the slide), and the equal outline now lets that show instead of shrinking the Ruby to hide it. Stack, measured on the render (ink rows): CRYSTAL label b378 (ink 362-377) / piece 400-588; RUBY b667 / 689-926; GREEN b1005 / 1027-1260; turn b1350, x-height top 1334. Each label's baseline sits 22 px above its own piece and its cap top 63-64 px under the piece above; the Green piece ends 73 px above the turn's x-height; the headline's last ink row (293) sits 69 px above the CRYSTAL label. Why 440 and a start at 400 rather than the art director's 420 from 386: the AD's figures (386-578 / 680-919 / 1021-1257) add each cut-out's full image height, which includes the trim's 12 px transparent margin on every side, so the visible pieces are shorter than that. At 420 from 386 the Green would end at 1189, leaving 145 px over the turn against 56 under the headline. 440, the top of the range, takes back some of that space, and starting the Crystal at 400 splits the rest evenly (69 above, 73 below). At the spec's equal 500 the same rhythm runs the Green to 1337, past the turn's x-height. Resolution: 0.52x, 0.51x and 0.52x native.

Slide 5 (and its fallback): the whole stack moves up 28px (headline b202/b308, turn b392/b444, photo y497-1157, footer b1240/b1286/b1328). As specified, the photo's bottom edge was 21px above the ascenders of 'every piece arrives in the naira gift box.', and the foot margin was 84px against a 160px top. The photo is the specified 820x660: a full-width cover crop of bold-nocturne-chain/05.jpg, y262-1228 (0.68x), with a 1px #E3D9CE border. The phone line, Jost 500 26px, carries .06em tracking, which the spec leaves unset.

Crystal build, slide 4: the headline reads 'ALSO IN RUBY / AND GREEN.' The spec's Crystal build covers slides 1-3 only, and a crystal-led post would otherwise say 'also in crystal'. The stack and labels are unchanged.

Claims: all three pieces are tagged 18k Gold Tone Plated and Cubic Zirconia (Edition Two). The art says only '18K GOLD TONE PLATED', 'RUBY-RED CUBIC ZIRCONIA', '36 CM', 'ABOUT 17 CM' and 'ABOUT 18 MM'. 'Gold' never appears bare; the alt text says gold-tone. GREEN is used, never emerald. There are no waterproof, tarnish-free or hypoallergenic words (the listings carry those tags, but the post does not use them), and no handmade, diamond, base-metal, delivery-date or urgency words. 'Free insured shipping', 'COD available' and 'every piece arrives in the naira gift box' are SAFE in the claim table; 'no COD fee' is never said. The hours (Mon to Sat, 10 to 7) and +91 95615 57935 match the brand bible.

Copy: no em or en dashes, exclamation marks or emoji in any visible text (checked headlessly on all nine pages). Middots appear only in Jost lines. Velista carries no ₹, ·, ° or accented letter, and its ligatures are off (GUEST, WHATSAPP and MUHURAT render with plain letters). Turns are lowercase and end with a full stop. The apostrophe is typographic (we’ll). Every line was measured in Chromium. There are no widows, clipped glyphs or overlaps; the one flagged box overlap is the two s3 note lines' Cormorant line boxes, inflated by the bill's rotation, with 46px baselines and clear space in the render.
